about_the_game:
The Cat said, "Let there be catnip," and there was catnip. The Cat also says, "You shall buy our game." So you did. 😼

Amidst the Wasteland, Beneath the Catnip. Your Purr-fect Empire Awaits.

【Game Introduction】

Welcome to TheLostCatCity, a claw-ful post-apocalyptic world where you play as a small black cat with big dreams! Once a glorious metropolis, the city now lies in ruins—a floating wasteland after the collapse of "Catnip Tech." As a stray trying to escape your "cat-astrophic" life, you arrive with one mission: plant the seeds of hope in this land of despair and claw your way to the top!

【Key Features】

🌱 Reclaim the Wasteland, Become a Farming Paw-fessional

  • Use your tiny paws to clear rubble and cultivate barren land. Start with your first catnip plant and watch hope blossom in this barren soil.

  • Dive deep into "Catnip Genetics"! Crossbreed and cultivate dozens of bizarre new varieties—from the irresistible "Rave Lightning Nip" to the healing "Therapeutic Star Mint." Build your exclusive catnip empire!

💰 Build Supply Chains, Become a Business Meow-gnate

  • Your harvested catnip isn’t just for your pleasure; it’s the hard currency for your fortune!

  • Start from a roadside stall, establish automated production lines, and build a business network across Meow City. Set prices, outsmart competitors, and make your brand the talk of the town!

🔫 Explore & Survive the Wasteland

  • This perilous land holds more than just opportunity. Roaming mechanical hounds and hostile stray cat gangs hide in the shadows.

  • Utilize an array of "feline-approved" weapons, from slingshots to laser pointers, to protect your farm and cargo. Explore every corner, unearthing old-world tech blueprints and treasures.

😼 Meet Quirky Lowpoly Companions

  • In this stylized world, all animal characters are crafted in distinct Lowpoly art, creating a charming contrast with the realistic wasteland.

  • Befriend a cast of unique animal residents: a shrewd fox merchant, a forgetful dog engineer, a haughty cat aristocrat. Complete their quests, and they might become your most valuable allies... or your most troublesome rivals.

🎉 A World Brimming with Cat Memes

  • This is a world built from cat memes! From "kneading" the controls of machinery to neighbors having "3 AM zoomies," every corner is filled with Easter eggs that will make cat lovers grin.

【Your Legendary Nine Lives】

From a penniless stray to a business tycoon with vast catnip fields—your every choice writes your unique legend.

Will you become a benevolent "Catnip Saint" or a market-monopolizing "Clawed Tyrant"? The choice is in your paws.

Wishlist TheLostCatCity now and don't miss the launch!
